text: Several visitors reported difficulty finding the library due to incorrect or unclear directions, including issues with the Google Maps location and lack of signage at nearby visitor centers. The timed ticket system caused frustration, as some guests were unaware of the requirement before arrival and found limited information outside the website. Customer service responsiveness was also criticized, with at least one visitor noting delays and unhelpful AI assistance when trying to change tickets. While many appreciated the architecture and interactive exhibits, some expressed disappointment with the absence of local North Dakota artists in the gift shop and questioned the use of AI content. Food and beverage options received mixed feedback, with at least one negative comment about quality.
